_comment: What KiCad does not know about the Griffin Jr. board for the enclosure. Lengths in mm.
heights: tallest point above the board TOP surface, matched against the footprint name
(substring, first match wins) or a reference (refs take precedence). 'verify' marks a
number taken from a data sheet or memory; measure the real part and clear the flag.
cutouts: per connector the MATING PLUG envelope (not the jack), the plug axis height zc
above the board top, and the lid-top label. case.scad adds 'slop' on every side.
notches: wall slots open at the split for the right-angle serial headers: the adapter
housing passes through the wall to reach pins that end at the board edge. z_top is the
notch top above the board top; tab_z is how far the bottom half's wall rises into it.
pillars: board coordinates (x right, y DOWN from the back edge like placement.json)
of the mid-board support pairs; board_geometry.py checks they are clear of pads, vias
fit model: stl/board.stl combines KiCad's 3D models (parts at least model_min_h tall) with
boxes for parts marked 'box' (sockets: the KiCad model is the empty socket) or lacking a
model, and right-angle headers drawn from pin_top/pin_len for the notch refs.

U6.note: Assmann A-CCS-084 PLCC-84 THT socket with the chip seated

Oscillator_DIP-8.note: full-can DIP-8 oscillator, KiCad model height

Crystal_HC49-U_Vertical.note: HC-49/U 13.46 body (KiCad model 13.1); an HC-49/US low-profile part is 4.5 and would shrink the lid by 2 mm

CP_Radial_D6.3mm.note: Rubycon ZLH 6.3 x 11; the KiCad model is only 6.3 tall

PinHeader_1x06.note: right-angle header fitted to the vertical footprint; top of the pins, measured 2026-11-17

PinHeader_2x05.note: vertical 2.54 header, used with the lid off

PinHeader_2x15.note: vertical 2.54 header, used with the lid off

J1.label: USB-C 5V
J1.note: USB-C plug overmould; the receptacle face is 2.5 mm behind the outer wall so the overmould must enter the hole

J5.label: VIDEO
J5.note: RCJ-041 barrel; it protrudes 9.4 mm past the board edge, through the wall

J10.label: S-VIDEO
J10.note: mini-DIN 4 plug grip, so the shell seats through the 2.5 mm standoff

J3.label: PS/2
J3.note: mini-DIN 6 plug grip; MD-60SM axis height from the data sheet

J6.label: AUDIO
J6.note: 3.5 mm plug body; SJ1-3523N axis height from the data sheet

J4.label: SD CARD
J4.note: microSD card; the slot gets slop on all sides and 1 mm extra height for a fingertip

J12.label: JOYSTICK
J12.note: DE-9 plug hood; the KiCad model's D face reaches 2.6 mm past the board edge, flush with the outer wall

J2.label: SERIAL A
J2.note: FTDI 1x6 socket housing 15.5 x 2.5; pin axis 6.0 above the board, housing bottom at 4.75

J11.label: SERIAL B
J11.note: pin_top: top of the horizontal pins above the board; pin_len: bend to tip, measured 2026-11-17
